Package com.csse3200.game.components.attacks

Class ChargeComponent

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.components.Component
com.csse3200.game.components.attacks.ChargeComponent
public class ChargeComponent extends Component
Represents a temporary charge state: a burst of movement speed toward a target, and a short-lived damage multiplier applied to whichever attack (melee or ranged) resolves next — NOT a separate damage-dealing hit of its own. Attack-type-agnostic: Minotaur pairs this with MeleeAttackComponent, Centaur pairs it with RangedAttackComponent; neither needs to know charging exists beyond checking for this component and reading getDamageMultiplier(). A separate damage-on-collision design was considered and rejected: it risks double-dipping if the entity's normal attack also fires around the same time as the collision. A pure multiplier on the next real attack avoids that — exactly one damage-dealing event per charge.

  • Constructor Details

    • ChargeComponent

      public ChargeComponent(float chargeDuration, float cooldown, float damageMultiplier)
      Creates a charge component.
      Parameters:
      chargeDuration - seconds a single charge lasts once started
      cooldown - minimum seconds between the end of one charge and the start of the next
      damageMultiplier - damage multiplier applied to the next attack while charging; must be greater than 1.0
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if speedMultiplier or damageMultiplier is not greater than 1.0, if chargeDuration is not positive, or if cooldown is negative

    • startCharge

      public void startCharge(com.badlogic.gdx.math.Vector2 direction)
      Begins a charge if canCharge() is true; otherwise a no-op. Starts the charge duration countdown only — no movement effect. Fires "chargeStart" on owning entity, an animation controller can listen for this to switch to a charging sprite, giving the player visual feedback even though there's no actual movement change.
      Parameters:
      direction - direction the charge is aimed toward - represents the target being charged at

    • getDamageMultiplier

      public float getDamageMultiplier()
      Returns the damage multiplier to apply to the next attack. Safe to call unconditionally — returns 1.0f (no change) whenever not currently charging, so callers never need to check isCharging() first.
      Returns:
      damageMultiplier while charging, otherwise 1.0f. No damage is dealt by this method.
